system.description:
Often sequestered in a lab, alchemists study the essence of creation. They are as curious as they are resourceful, and always have “just the thing for this.”


Iconic Alchemists

• The Colorman, Sacré Bleu

• Diablo, Marvel Comics

• Dr. Jekyll, Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde

• Tessa Cade, Defy the Night


Playing Alchemist

The alchemist is a low-defense, high-damage-and-utility blaster. It’s recommended you stay Far from Enemies to use Alchemical Items.


Action: Use (Craft & Attack)

Move: Backline


Training: Arcana, Craft, Medicine

features.name: Alchemy
features.description:
Choose 4 Alchemical Items (p. 84) with a value no higher than (your Level × 50s). You only need 5s of Materials and Alchemy Tools equipped to Craft them.


You learn to Craft 1 other Alchemical Item this way every 2 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Catalyze
features.description: You gain the Deft Hands Perk, and can Craft Alchemical Items with the Use Action.

features.name: Eureka
features.description: When you pass a Craft Check by 10 or more, you gain a Studied die. The roll required to do so is decreased by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Potency
features.description:
The damage and healing dice of your Alchemical Items can Explode.


At 8th Level, they can Explode on a roll of their two highest values.

features.name: Mix
features.description: You can combine two Alchemical Items together with the Use Action by spending a Studied die, causing both Items to occur simultaneously when used. The combined Item goes inert at the start of your next Turn.

features.name: Prima Materia
features.description: Once per Day, you can Craft an Alchemical Item with a value as high as 10g without Materials.
